content: When Cree comes back as an IA, use the sexiest farm animals joke as the password  “Brown Chicken brown cow” We find ourselves in a new universe, the AI’s are taking over planet by planet the galaxy, no one is safe, the Empire and the Republic have joined forces and things are not going well.  There is little hope they will win, when Blake begins to receive odd messages, telling him to come find “The Prize”. With the crew of the Revenant, Blake goes in search of this prize, his daughter has gone her own way and Tells  Blake  to let her be, he reluctantly does (Opens the door for Orion’s Child).  He follows the trail , to some pretty dangerous places until he finally finds the dreadnought, a massive planet killer that had been hidden by the Ancients,  Cree’s  digital mind , since dying had lived among the galactic  communication  systems  until  he found the ship.
